mapper.select: SELECT id, classroom_id, question_id, question_title, publish_order, is_required, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM mg_classroom_question WHERE classroom_id = #{classroomId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY publish_order ASC, create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE mg_classroom_question SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cq.id, cq.classroom_id, cr.course_id, cr.course_name as classroom_name, cq.question_id, cq.question_title, cq.publish_order, cq.score, cq.is_required, cq.start_time, cq.end_time FROM mg_classroom_question cq LEFT JOIN mg_course_record cr ON cq.classroom_id = cr.id AND cr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cq.classroom_id = #{classroomId} AND cq.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cq.publish_order ASC, cq.create_time ASC
